name: context-graph
description: Capture Codex runtime activity through Memgraph Context Graph hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Send Codex lifecycle events to Memgraph Context Graph and recall past sessions.
interface.longDescription: Installs Codex lifecycle hooks that call the Memgraph Context Graph hook CLI, allowing graph connectors such as Skills Graph to persist useful runtime context in Memgraph. Needs the memgraph-context-graph tool: run the AI Memory setup (https://memgraph.com/docs/ai-ecosystem/ai-memory/get-started) or the plugin's setup skill.
defaultPrompt: Check whether context graph hooks are installed.
Explain what Codex events are captured.
Show recent skill usage in Memgraph.
